column1: # Labelled raster firings — is this call worth making?
# Every standalone_raster the router fired on across four journal/paper
# corpora, classified by rendering the image and looking at it.
#   branding = publisher furniture: masthead, society logo, conference
#              banner, QR code, cover art, decorative icon. A false positive:
#              carries nothing the extracted text lacks.
#   portrait = author/staff headshot. Debatable, scored separately, never
#              counted as branding in headline numbers.
#   content  = a figure, chart, photo, scan, diagram or table image.
# Built by eval/../scratch tooling; the verdict column is human, by eye.
